$comment: pnpm assets:build settings (mw-e37.8, style bible §13.2). textureSize is the High tier's longest texture side; Low is High × lowScale. maxTriangles is the LOD0 budget the build refuses to exceed. A model's assets/source/<category>/<id>/build.json may override textureSize, maxTriangles and simplifyRatio (vertices kept, 0–1; the only decimation the build does). Bump pipelineVersion when the pipeline changes so every model rebuilds.
